catalog_actions.name: Relocate one machine
catalog_actions.notes: Moves happen at a gaming-day boundary to an empty or swapped slot.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Relocate one low-traffic machine to prime corridor; unlocks 30%-50% coin-in lift.

catalog_actions.name: Relocate a whole bank
catalog_actions.notes: All machines in the bank move together.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Relocate entire 6-machine bank together to re-energize zone sightlines.

catalog_actions.name: Replace a machine with a leased new title
catalog_actions.notes: Lease runs for the remainder of the horizon.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Replace underperformer with modern leased title; requires ongoing daily lease royalty.

catalog_actions.name: Replace a machine with a purchased new title
catalog_actions.notes: Capital cost charged to this budget in full.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Capital replacement with owned new title. 4+ year payback period.

catalog_actions.name: Add one technician to a shift for 30 days
catalog_actions.notes: 8 h x 30 days at the supplied labor rate.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Add 1 technician to Swing Shift (14:00-22:00) for 30 days, cutting repair turnaround from 3.82h to 2.4h.

catalog_actions.name: Preventive maintenance sweep for one manufacturer
catalog_actions.notes: 90 minutes downtime per machine, scheduled in quiet hours.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: OEM preventive sweep for Ridgeline machines, preventing ~35% of recurrent component breakdowns.

catalog_actions.name: Machine inspection and paytable verification
catalog_actions.notes: Outcome is information, not a guaranteed finding.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Verify ROM chips, paytable integrity and meters on statistical anomaly machines (e.g. M-1158).

catalog_actions.name: Wayfinding and signage refresh for a zone
catalog_actions.notes: Signage and sightline changes; no construction.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Signage and overhead sightline enhancements to drive traffic into under-visited zones.

catalog_actions.name: Comp policy pilot with control group
catalog_actions.notes: Design, training and tracking only; comp costs still flow through POS cogs.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: 1,000-player targeted comp pilot (f&b reinvestment raised to 4%), driving repeat visits with 27.93% COGS leverage.

catalog_actions.name: Change comp redemption rate floor-wide
catalog_actions.notes: Point cost per comp dollar can be set between 5 and 20.
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Floor-wide comp redemption rule change. High unhedged margin risk if player response is uncalibrated.

catalog_actions.name: Property promotion weekend
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Property promotion weekend with marketing and prizes. Short-lived demand spike.

catalog_actions.name: Expanded guest intercept survey
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Triple monthly guest intercept survey sample to refine visitor churn intelligence.

catalog_actions.name: Preserve budget
catalog_actions.strategic_desc: Preserve budget in treasury cash reserves for post-pilot Q4 rollouts.

actions.note: Eliminates bottleneck on shift capturing 47.8% of faults

recommendations.key_assumption: Technician cuts average swing repair time by 1.42 hours; recovered machine uptime yields floor average win.

recommendations.key_assumption: Relocated bank experiences 40% coin-in lift toward Center Stage benchmark.

constraint_rules.action_type_limit: A maximum of 3 distinct action types can be deployed in the July intervention.
constraint_rules.quantity_limits: Each action type must strictly adhere to the catalog quantity limits.

incompatibility_groups.same_machine: Cannot perform both A-REPLACE-BUY/LEASE and A-MOVE-MACHINE on the same machine.
incompatibility_groups.comp_policy: Cannot combine A-COMP-PILOT with floor-wide A-COMP-CHANGE simultaneously.
